summary: Describes Simple Virtual Aggregation (S-VA), a technique that lets some BGP routers avoid installing every route from the default-free routing table into their forwarding table. The idea is to reduce forwarding table size. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Instead of every mailbox carrying a map of every street, some boxes get a shorter map and send hard questions to ones that know more.

questions: how to shrink the bgp fib
reduce routing table size in the dfz
